text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 12, "unit": "pounds", "kind": "count", "span": "12 pounds"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 50, "unit": "%", "kind": "count", "span": "50% more"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 40, "unit": "dwarves", "kind": "count", "span": "40 dwarves"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 30, "unit": "days", "kind": "count", "span": "30 days"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q1"], "out": "s1", "note": "iron pickaxe rate = twice the bare-hand rate (12+12)"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "q1"], "out": "s2", "note": "steel pickaxe rate = iron rate plus 50 percent of the iron rate; since the iron rate is already double q1, 50 percent of it equals q1 exactly, so steel rate = s1 + q1"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "total pounds mined per day by 40 dwarves with steel pickaxes"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s3", "q4"], "out": "s4", "note": "total pounds mined over the 30-day month"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "total pounds of ore that 40 dwarves with steel pickaxes can mine in a 30-day month"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 50, "reason": "the 50 percent figure is not used as a direct operand: since the steel rate is 50 percent more than a rate that is itself double q1, that portion algebraically equals q1 exactly, so it is folded into the add(s1,q1) step instead of a separate percentage operation"}]}
